speaker: alse_pinder
text: They're crying it in the street. Tomorrow, on Tower Hill.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard them from the stair. I am not going down to the crier.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Today's bill is still up. I am not the man who takes a Thursday down before I have said so at the door.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I shut the street door?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut it if the noise bothers the loom. Not on my account.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Verbeke is at his thread. Leave him there. Dinner can be early if the Theatre wants you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This afternoon. Tomorrow is the day that comes off the board.
